Example Data for Bayesian Age Model

Source: R/Catalhoyuk.R
Catalhoyuk.Rd

Example Data for Bayesian Age Model

Usage

Catalhoyuk

Format

A list with 3 elements :

StratiConstraints

Stratigraphic Matrix for BayLum Adaptation

C14ages

C14 ages

C14agesEr

C14 errors

C14_Nb_sample

C14 sample size

C14_SampleNames

C14 sample names

Output

C14 Ages estimation
